accepted_art: Five original #410 ingredient sprites accepted under CA410-INGREDIENTS-01 on2026-10-26. Dough is an existing candidate source; its author acceptance is not implied. No icon pixels replaced.
method: Closed volumes derived from the observed owned ingredient references; thick continuously closed sack/paper walls with real mouths, vegetable cluster with70 closed connected corn kernels, continuous organic steak and fat edge, tapered rounded hake flesh with a connected narrow skin strip. Shared closed geometry, folded package geometry and per-face planar UVs where appropriate. Existing source pixels unchanged.
limits: Six native untiered material identities only. Recipes, preparation/cooking, amounts, lot/provenance behavior, weight, collision, scale and saves stay unchanged. Sacks and wrapping are presentation only. Static art approximation is subject to native and author review.
iterations: Retained model01/02 flat steak/fillet, compressed sack and packet UVs; model03 planar package UVs, rounder steak and flesh, with visibly separated skin slab and potato/dough projection seams; model04 narrows skin to an overlapping strip, restores spherical potato/dough mapping and adds kernel volumes; model05 fills corn gaps with wider overlapping kernels. Exact captures remain evidence of candidate limitations.
